subject: science
concept: Understanding how the five senses send information to the brain
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student performs simple sensory tests (identifying an object by touch alone) and discusses how the brain interprets the input
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a sense organ to the type of information it detects
exercise.abstract: Student explains what happens when a described sense organ detects something

misconception_flags: believes sense organs 'think' independently rather than sending signals to the brain

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
